description.value: MR MIKES is a casual steakhouse chain with roots dating back to 1960, serving Canadian classics including premium steaks, burgers, pastas, salads, and shareable appetizers in a relaxed, no-dress-code atmosphere on Terrace's main commercial strip. The Terrace location welcomes walk-ins and accepts reservations, and the brand positions itself as a welcoming community gathering spot for locals and tourists alike. Touring cyclists passing through Terrace's North Coast corridor will find it a full sit-down dining option with online ordering and takeout available.
